correctness.rationale: Exact joint CPTP map reduces to a three-component invariant recursion, confirmed by 1,432 independent direct four-by-four checks. The cubic at perfect exchange has distinct roots sqrt(lambda), -sqrt(lambda), -lambda. Analytic perturbation yields explicit first-order modal modulus splitting, coefficients approaching 1/2,1/2,0 and parity sign count with uniform exponentially suppressed third mode. Even increments are eventually always negative, odd increments switch sign near K/epsilon, proving epsilon*R -> K/2. State-pair trace distance equals system excitation. No finite numerical enumeration is used as an infinite proof.
